title: Toys 4 Tots Fundraiser
seo_title: Toys 4 Tots Fundraiser at The Vineyard Market in Ozark
description: This holiday toy drive at The Vineyard Market collects new, unwrapped toys valued at $20 or more for Toys 4 Tots, and each donation earns a complimentary glass of wine as a thank-you. The donations help brighten the holidays for children in the community, and reservations can be made by calling (417) 882-0399 or online. It takes place Friday, December 4, 2026 at 11:00 AM at 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO.
